flow_ref: There is no OCMS flow deck; steps are taken from the story text. Sheet status: Demo paid (50% of 75%); demo_remark: Vault & SMS code split, SMS permission for the api App Service server may be needed, 'I recall seeing a court SMS on test phone' (a claim, not evidence).
code_summary: The SMS path lives in the eNotification job (ocmsadminprivateapi): contacts from DataHive (when the flag is on), grouping per recipient (combineNotices), then sendBatchSms through SmsUtil to APIM. All of it is for parking reminder SMS RD1 to DR3; there is no court summons template or data. In prod sms.enable=false without sms.allowedSources (dev/uat have ENOTIFICATION) and cron.notification.enabled=false, so by repo config no SMS leaves.
note: Status 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)' and the note 'court SMS on test phone' are demo claims; the repo has no court content. SMS permission on the App Service and numbers received from DOS cannot verify from repo. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-180 is only a hint that the eNotification cron is not yet active.
recommendation: Sebagian: batch SMS infrastructure exists but with no court summons content or selection, and SMS is switched off in the prod repo config. Do not claim in full.

steps.step: Mobile numbers are obtained from DOS
steps.detail: refreshIndividualContactInfo gets the number through DataHive Singpass (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2710-2716) but only when statusGetDatahive = true (:2468); prod cron.enareminder.datahive=false (cron-schedules-prod.properties:48; real server value cannot verify from repo). DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo. Same fact as OCMS24.14 step 2 and OCMS9.4, both Sebagian.

steps.step: Unique individual defendants are identified for the SMSes in each batch job
steps.detail: combineNotices groups records per recipient (I_<id_no>) + stage + paymentDueDate so one person gets one SMS for reminder stages (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2151-2200); ENA for individuals is deliberately not combined (:2168-2173). Applies to parking reminders, not a court summons batch. Same as OCMS9.5 (Sebagian).

steps.step: The SMS contains details of the court summonses
steps.detail: The SMS body is built from a per-stage template through prepareTemplateData and determineTemplateName (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:425-430, :459) with VON data for stages RD1 to DR3. The word court appears in neither the helper, the job nor SmsUtil; no court summons data goes into the message. The demo claim 'court SMS on test phone' has no code basis in the six repos.

steps.step: OCMS sends the SMS reminder to the defendant through the SMS gateway
steps.detail: sendBatchSms calls smsUtil.sendBatchSmsSimple (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1527, :1611) to APIM, invoked by the job when notification.sms.enabled=true (application.properties:176; NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:289-291). But prod has sms.enable=false (application-prod.properties:87) without sms.allowedSources (only dev/uat set ENOTIFICATION) and cron.notification.enabled=false (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236). The real server value and SMS permission on the App Service cannot verify from repo; the path is for parking reminders.
